title: Senior DevOps Engineer – Google Cloud Platform (GCP)
description:
About This Role
**5 to 8 years of experience**  

**Skills: GCP**

Senior DevOps Engineer – Google Cloud Platform (GCP)


Experience


* 5–8 Years


Location


India


Employment Type


Full\-Time


Reporting Structure


This role will report to the Cloud Infrastructure Engineering Lead (Huming) and will be part of the Cloud Infrastructure team, operating independently from the application engineering team led by Fadi.


Job Summary


We are seeking a highly skilled Senior DevOps Engineer – GCP to join our Cloud Infrastructure Engineering team. The ideal candidate will have extensive experience designing, implementing, automating, and managing cloud\-native infrastructure on Google Cloud Platform (GCP).


This role will be responsible for building and maintaining scalable, secure, and highly available cloud infrastructure while driving Infrastructure as Code (IaC), Kubernetes platform engineering, CI/CD automation, and cloud governance initiatives. The successful candidate will work closely with development, security, and platform engineering teams to enable reliable software delivery and operational excellence.


Key Responsibilities


* Design, implement, and manage scalable cloud infrastructure on Google Cloud Platform (GCP).

* Develop and manage Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using Terraform.

* Design, implement, and optimize CI/CD pipelines for automated application deployments.

* Containerize applications using Docker and manage container orchestration using Kubernetes.

* Automate infrastructure provisioning, configuration management, and deployment processes.

* Monitor cloud environments to ensure availability, reliability, performance, and cost optimization.

* Implement cloud security best practices, IAM policies, networking, and compliance controls.

* Collaborate with application development teams to support cloud\-native application deployments.

* Troubleshoot infrastructure, deployment, networking, and Kubernetes\-related issues.

Scripting \& Automation


* Bash

* Python

Version Control


* Git

* GitHub

* GitLab

Monitoring \& Observability


* Google Cloud Monitoring

* Google Cloud Logging

* Prometheus

* Grafana

Security

* Secret Management

* SSL/TLS

* Vulnerability Management

* Container Security

Required Qualifications


* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field.

* 5–8 years of experience in DevOps, Cloud Infrastructure, or Platform Engineering.
* Strong hands\-on experience with Google Cloud Platform (GCP).

* Experience managing production Kubernetes clusters using Google Kubernetes Engine (GKE).

* Proven expertise in Terraform and Infrastructure as Code practices.

* Experience designing and maintaining CI/CD pipelines.

* Strong understanding of Linux systems administration.

title: Lead Site Reliability Engineer
description:
**Lead Site Reliability Engineer**

  

**WHAT MAKES US, US**
---------------------

Join some of the most innovative thinkers in FinTech as we lead the evolution of financial technology. If you are an innovative, curious, collaborative person who embraces challenges and wants to grow, learn, and pursue outcomes with our prestigious financial clients, say Hello to SimCorp!


At its foundation, SimCorp is guided by our values — caring, customer success\-driven, collaborative, curious, and courageous. Our people\-centered organization focuses on skills development, relationship building, and client success. We take pride in cultivating an environment where all team members can grow, feel heard, valued, and empowered.


If you like what we’re saying, keep reading!  



  

**WHY THIS ROLE IS IMPORTANT TO US**

As a Lead Site Reliability Engineer, you will join one of our Product Areas and become part of a collaborative team focused on operating and improving our Azure\-based SaaS platform. You’ll work with experienced engineers and cross\-functional colleagues to help ensure reliability, scalability, and operational excellence for both onboarding and running client environments.


This role is a launchpad for your development as an SRE—combining hands\-on engineering, automation, monitoring, and platform support—with strong mentorship and continuous learning opportunities built in.  



  

**What you will be responsible for**

* Work hands\-on across platform and infrastructure SRE activities — cloud infrastructure, Kubernetes/container platforms, CI/CD, and production systems — not just reviewing or delegating this work, but building and operating it directly.
* Define, own, and report on SLIs, SLOs, and SLAs for critical services; manage error budgets and use them to drive concrete engineering and release decisions.
* Actively participate in cost optimization efforts across cloud and platform infrastructure, identifying and implementing efficiency and rightsizing opportunities (FinOps practices).
* Lead the design and implementation of strategies to ensure the reliability, scalability, and performance of critical systems and services.
* Manage incident response, troubleshooting, and root cause analysis for system outages and performance issues, ensuring timely resolution and prevention of future incidents.
* Develop and maintain monitoring, alerting, and automation systems to enhance service reliability and reduce manual intervention, including automation and AI\-driven engineering approaches (e.g. AI\-assisted anomaly detection, automated remediation, AI\-supported incident triage) to reduce toil and speed up resolution.
* Collaborate with development, operations, and product teams to optimize application performance and system infrastructure.
* Drive initiatives for capacity planning, resource management, and scalability to meet growing business needs.
* Implement continuous improvement processes to enhance the reliability and efficiency of systems and services.

  

**What we value**

* Mentor and guide junior site reliability engineers, fostering a culture of collaboration and knowledge\-sharing, while remaining personally hands\-on with the underlying systems.
* Participate in on\-call rotations, providing leadership during critical incidents and ensuring minimal downtime.
* Create and maintain documentation for incident management, system configurations, and operational processes.
* Drive the adoption of industry best practices, tools, and technologies — including automation and AI\-driven engineering tooling — to enhance system reliability and operational performance.

  

**BENEFITS**

Attractive salary, bonus scheme, and pension are essential for any work agreement. However, in SimCorp we believe we can offer more. Therefore, in addition to the traditional benefit scheme, we provide a good work\-life balance: flexible working hours and a hybrid model. Simcorp follows a global hybrid policy, asking employees to work from the office two days each week while allowing remote work on other days.


Simcorp does offer opportunities for professional development: there is never just only one route \- we offer an individual approach to professional development to support the direction you want to take.  



  

**NEXT STEPS**

Please send us your application in English via our career site as soon as possible, we process incoming applications continually. Please note that only applications sent through our system will be processed. At SimCorp, we recognize that bias can unintentionally occur in the recruitment process. To uphold fairness and equal opportunities for all applicants, we kindly ask you to exclude personal data such as photos, age, or any non\-professional information from your application. Thank you for aiding us in our endeavor to mitigate biases in our recruitment process.


If you are interested in being a part of SimCorp but are not sure this role is suitable, submit your CV anyway. SimCorp is on a positive growth journey, and our Talent Acquisition Team is ready to assist you discover the right role for you. The approximate time to consider your CV is three weeks.


We are focused on continually improving our talent acquisition process and making everyone’s experience positive and valuable. Therefore, during the process we will ask you to provide your feedback, which is highly appreciated.  



  

**WHO WE ARE**

For over 50 years, we have worked closely with investment and asset managers to become the world’s leading provider of integrated investment management solutions. We are 3,000\+ colleagues with a broad range of nationalities, educations, professional experiences, ages, and backgrounds.


SimCorp is an independent subsidiary of the Deutsche Börse Group. Following the recent merger with Axioma, we leverage the combined strength of our brands to provide an industry\-leading, full, front\-to\-back offering for our clients.


SimCorp is an equal opportunity employer and welcome applicants from all backgrounds, without regard to race, gender, age, disability, or any other protected status under applicable law. We are committed to building a culture where diverse perspectives and expertise are integrated into our everyday work. We believe in the continual growth and development of our employees, so that we can provide best\-in\-class solutions to our clients.

title: Systems Operations Senior Manager (SRE, Production Ops, Operational Excellence)
description:
**About this role:**

* Wells Fargo is seeking a **Systems Operations Senior Manager**.
* The **Senior Systems Operations Manager** is responsible for **leading Platform teams** for **site reliability engineering (SRE)**, **production operations**, and **operational excellence**. This leader drives platform availability, resiliency, stability, incident management, service restoration, automation, operational risk management, and continuous improvement initiatives supporting critical systems.
* The role partners closely with Engineering, Product Management, Infrastructure, Cybersecurity, Architecture, Business Operations, and Vendor teams to ensure secure, reliable, scalable, and compliant technology services.

 **In this role, you will:**

* Manage and develop teams of analysts, associates, and less experienced managers in roles that provide technical services and support for the relevant supported systems
* Engage and influence stakeholders, internal partners, and peers in order to engineer projects, identify new products and solutions, and research solutions for existing systems
* Identify and recommend opportunities for administration and maintenance of the remote monitoring and management system, as well as the periodic system review
* Perform network assessments, security audits, and system enhancement consultations
* Determine appropriate strategy and actions of Systems Operations team to meet moderate to high\-risk deliverables
* Interpret and develop policies and procedures, and understand compliance and risk management requirements for supported system area
* Provide implementation support for key risk initiatives
* Collaborate with and influence all levels of professionals, analysts, or associates
* Ensure the Systems Operations team communicates with customers to keep them informed of incident progress, and notify them of impending changes or agreed outages
* Manage allocation of people and financial resources for Systems Operations
* Develop and guide a culture of talent development to meet business objectives and strategy

 **Required Qualifications:**

* 7\+ years of Systems Engineering and Technology Architecture experience, or equivalent demonstrated through one or a combination of the following: work experience, training, military experience, education
* 3\+ years of management or leadership experience

 **Additional Required Qualifications**

* 7\+ years of technology operations, platform support, production support, SRE, infrastructure operations, or application support.
* 3\+ years of leadership experience managing large technology operations teams.
* Strong experience supporting mission\-critical enterprise applications in highly regulated environments.
* Experience leading Major Incident Management and executive communications.
* Deep expertise in:
* Application Support
* Platform Operations
* Incident Management
* Problem Management
* Change Management
* Service Management
* Operational Risk
* SRE Practices
* ITIL Frameworks
* Experience managing globally distributed teams and vendors.
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience.

 **Job Expectation:**

* **Platform Operations Leadership**


o Lead multiple platform support and production operations teams supporting various applications and services.


o Establish operational strategy, service level objectives (SLOs), service level indicators (SLIs), and operational governance frameworks.


o Drive 24x7 operational excellence and ensure adherence to enterprise technology standards.


o Develop operational roadmaps aligned to platform modernization and business transformation objectives.


o Manage geographically distributed teams across multiple locations.

* **Reliability \& Service Availability**


o Accountable for platform reliability, system health, availability, performance, and resilience.


o Implement proactive monitoring, observability, event management, and predictive operational capabilities.


o Drive service stability initiatives through operational reviews, trend analysis, and reliability engineering practices.


o Ensure platform capacity, scalability, performance, and recovery readiness.

* **Incident, Problem \& Change Management**


o Provide executive leadership during major incidents and business\-impacting technology outages.


o Own incident command processes, stakeholder communications, escalation management, and service recovery.


o Drive root cause analysis and problem management activities.


o Establish sustainable corrective actions to eliminate recurring incidents.


o Ensure change implementation is executed with minimal operational risk.

* **Site Reliability Engineering (SRE)**


o Lead adoption of SRE principles across supported platforms.


o Reduce operational toil through automation, self\-healing capabilities, and intelligent operations.


o Improve system reliability through error budget management and service maturity assessments.


o Partner with development teams to embed reliability into solution design and deployment practices.

* **Automation \& Operational Transformation**


o Drive operational automation strategy and execution.


o Expand use of AIOps, predictive analytics, observability, deployment automation, runbook automation, and intelligent monitoring.


o Deliver operational efficiencies through modernization and platform engineering practices.


o Champion continuous improvement and operational transformation initiatives.

* **Risk, Compliance \& Governance**


o Ensure compliance with enterprise operational risk, security, audit, and regulatory requirements.


o Govern production controls, access management, resiliency testing, disaster recovery, business continuity planning, and vendor oversight.


o Support internal audits, regulatory examinations, and risk reviews.


o Maintain strong risk management discipline across all supported technology services.

o Manage operational budgets, vendor relationships, contracts, and resource planning.


o Evaluate vendor service levels and operational performance.

title: Senior Dev Ops Engineer
description:

description:

title: Senior DevOps Engineer - Cloud Platform
description:
**Role : Senior DevOps Engineer (5 \- 9 Years Experience)**

**Role Overview :**

Our client is seeking a Senior DevOps / Cloud Platform Engineer with 5 to 9 years of experience to lead, design, and modernize our cloud infrastructure and automated deployment pipelines. In this role, you will act as a key architect and practitioner across our Azure cloud ecosystem, enterprise Kubernetes environments, and Infrastructure\-as\-Code (IaC) tooling.

You will be responsible for building secure, scalable multi\-stage CI/CD pipelines, driving zero\-downtime microservice deployments on AKS, establishing reusable Terraform modules, and automating complex cloud operations with Python and Shell/PowerShell.

**Cloud \& CI/CD (Azure \& Azure DevOps) :**

\- **Pipeline Engineering** : Design, build, and maintain production\-grade, secure multi\-stage YAML pipelines in Azure DevOps for complex multi\-tier applications.

\- **Release \& Branching Strategy** : Establish and enforce robust Git branching strategies (e.g., GitFlow, Trunk\-Based Development) and governance for source control and release management.

\- **Native Azure Management :** Architect and manage enterprise Azure services including Azure Virtual Networks, App Services, Azure Functions, Key Vaults, Private Endpoints, and Identity \& Access Management (IAM/RBAC).

**Containerization \& Kubernetes (Docker \& AKS) :**

\- **Cluster Management** : Provision, harden, and operate production\-ready Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS) clusters, ensuring high availability, observability, and cost optimization.

\- **Container Optimization** : Author production\-ready, security\-scanned multi\-stage Dockerfiles to minimize image footprints and attack surfaces.

\- **Application Delivery** : Packaging and managing complex microservice deployments using Helm charts and values files tailored to target environments.

\- **Networking \& Security** : Implement and maintain K8s network policies, Ingress Controllers (NGINX/AGIC), service meshes, TLS certificate management, and secret integration.

**Infrastructure as Code (Terraform) :**

\- **Modular IaC** : Author and maintain clean, modular, and reusable Terraform configurations for multi\-environment Azure landing zones.

\- **State Management** : Enforce robust state\-management patterns using remote backend storage, state locking, state splitting, and secure secret handling.

\- **Governance \& Standards** : Implement automated linting, policy\-as\-code checks, and drift detection mechanisms.

**Automation \& Tooling (Python, Bash, PowerShell) :**

\- **Advanced Scripting** : Develop automated operational workflows, health checks, and system maintenance tasks using robust Bash or PowerShell scripts.

\- **SDK/API Integration** : Write Python scripts leveraging the Azure SDK and REST APIs to create custom automation tools, reporting scripts, and pipeline extensions.

**Soft Skills \& Leadership Expectation :**

\- **Problem Solving** : Proven ability to troubleshoot complex cloud networking, container orchestrations, and deployment issues under operational timelines.

\- **Collaboration \& Governance** : Strong communication skills to partner with Software Engineering, Cyber Security, and Enterprise Architecture teams.

\- **Mentorship** : Ability to mentor mid\-level/junior engineers and conduct code reviews for Terraform, YAML pipelines, and scripts.

\- **Security Mindset** : Deep understanding of DevSecOps practices embedding shift\-left security checks, secret scanning, and compliance into daily workflows.

Pay: ₹2,000,000\.00 \- ₹3,000,000\.00 per year

Work Location: In person

title: Site Reliability Engineer
description:
**Job Description** **WHAT YOU’LL DO**


As a **Site Reliability Engineer (SRE)**, you will be responsible for building and maintaining robust, automated systems that reduce manual intervention and improve overall system efficiency. They play a key role in incident response, performance optimization, and infrastructure management, often working closely with development teams to integrate reliability into the software development lifecycle

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Develop, test, and maintain high\-quality software solutions, frameworks and automations.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to analyse requirements and design solutions around stability and reliability.
* Participate in code reviews to ensure code quality and shared knowledge.
* Identify, troubleshoot, and resolve various incidents, problems ensure DevOps/SRE best practices.
* Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives within the engineering team.
* Assist in mentoring junior engineers by providing guidance and feedback.

**WHO YOU’LL WORK WITH**


At H\&M, you’ll be part of a global, cross\-functional team focused on enabling data driven decision making at the core of our customer offering. Our mission is to empower assortment teams to efficiently and accurately plan and adjust demand for articles across all markets and touchpoints, with the flexibility to swiftly adapt to changing circumstances.


At H \& M you’ll be with the **Digital Foundation** area which is integral part of the **Commercial Tech Domain**. This area builds on the existing Product Operations and Online Applications units, reflecting the organization’s evolution toward a more integrated digital capability and focusing on enabling teams to deliver with excellence. **E2E Digital Operations** \- Critical product going forward, strengthening core capabilities in our new way of operating and supporting the E2E of our developing decoupled tech landscape.


You will work closely with a Product Manager (PM), Engineering Manager (EM), and Tech Lead to define, prioritize, and deliver frontend initiatives aligned with product and business goals. Together, you will ensure clear ownership, strong technical direction, and high\-quality execution of deliverables.

**WHO YOU ARE**

We are looking for people with...

* 3\+ years of experience in Site Reliability Engineering, maintenance \& amp; operations and/or development.
* Strong working experience eCommerce.
* Hands\-on experience with Firebase (Crashlytics, Performance Monitoring, Remote Config, inApp Messaging).
* Experience operating mobile applications in production: crash and ANR triage, stability rate ownership, release management through App Store Connect and Google Play Console.
* Working knowledge of the Apple and Google release model: review guidelines and approval flow, phased rollouts, app signing, certificate and APNs key management, annual OS releases and target API level deadlines.
* Experience supporting multiple app versions live in production simultaneously, with backward\-compatible API and a minimum supported version strategy.
* Experience mitigating production issues without shipping a new build: remote config, feature flags, kill switches, server\-side fixes.
* Experience defining SLIs / SLOs for mobile (crash\-free users and sessions, ANR rate, app start time, client\-side API error and latency rates) and analysing them by app version, OS version, device model and market.
* Comfortable using store reviews and ratings as an operational signal alongside technical telemetry
* Experience within solutions architecture and how to fast pinpoint causes of issues

**WHO WE ARE**

H\&M is a global company of strong fashion brands and ventures. Our goal is to prove that there is no compromise between exceptional design, affordable prices, and sustainable solutions. We want to liberate fashion for the many, and our customers are at the heart of every decision we make. We are made up of thousands of passionate and talented colleagues united by our shared culture and values. Together, we want to use our power, our scale, and our knowledge to push the fashion industry towards a more inclusive and sustainable future. Help us re\-imagine fashion and together we will re\-shape our industry. Learn more about H\&M here.

**WHY YOU’LL LOVE WORKING HERE**


At H\&M, we are proud to be a vibrant and welcoming company. We offer all our employees at H\&M attractive benefits with extensive development opportunities around the globe. All our employees receive a staff discount card, useable on all our H\&M brands in stores and online. Brands covered by the discount are H\&M (Beauty and Move included), COS, Weekday, Monki, H\&M HOME, \& Other Stories, ARKET, Afound.

**JOIN US**

title: Platform Engineer - DevOps
description:
**Your Future Evolves Here**


Evolent partners with health plans and providers to achieve better outcomes for people with most complex and costly health conditions. Working across specialties and primary care, we seek to connect the pieces of fragmented health care system and ensure people get the same level of care and compassion we would want for our loved ones.


Evolent employees enjoy work/life balance, the flexibility to suit their work to their lives, and autonomy they need to get things done. We believe that people do their best work when they're supported to live their best lives, and when they feel welcome to bring their whole selves to work. That's one reason why diversity and inclusion are core to our business.


Join Evolent for the mission. Stay for the culture.

**What You’ll Be Doing:**

**Why This Role Matters**
=========================


Evolent is transforming how it builds and operates infrastructure under a refreshed Platform Engineering \& Operations operating model, grounded in four principles: Architecture First, Automation by Default, Reliability is a Shared Responsibility and Golden Paths Over Custom Solutions. You will turn approved designs into provisioned, automated, and documented platforms, and you will do it transparently, through formal handoffs, Office Hours reviews, and documentation your peers can actually rely on.

**Agentic AI**: Platform Engineering is moving toward agentic AI as a standard part of how the organization works. As agentic AI transforms the way we work, we expect our engineers to be at the forefront of that change, designing and building intelligent solutions rather than simply consuming them. This builder mentality is a core attribute we assess from the first conversation.

**What You'll Be Doing**
========================

* Provision and change infrastructure exclusively as code, so that every environment is reproducible, reviewable, and free of manual drift.
* Reverse engineer the applications and infrastructure you inherit: trace dependencies, integrations, and data flows end to end until you can explain how a system actually works.
* Design and build agentic AI solutions for platform, delivery, and operations work: identify the toil worth automating, then build, evaluate, and harden the agent that removes it.
* Build security and compliance into the delivery path: least\-privilege access, secrets handling, policy\-as\-code guardrails, and audit evidence produced by design rather than assembled under deadline.
* Design, build, and maintain CI/CD pipelines in GitHub Actions and Azure Pipelines that deliver consistent, secure, and repeatable deployments.
* Enable container\-based application delivery on Docker and Kubernetes, with a focus on Azure Kubernetes Service and Azure Container Apps.
* Build reusable cloud\-native infrastructure, pipelines, and self\-service capabilities that support secure and scalable delivery, including AI and ML workloads.
* Develop APIs, automation scripts, and platform integrations that remove repeat manual requests from engineering teams.
* Support and guide application teams through containerization and modern deployment patterns, and debug complex issues across the application, platform, and infrastructure layers.
* Work within agile delivery practices such as Kanban, Scrumban, and sprints to plan and deliver your work transparently.


To ensure a secure hiring process we have implemented several identity verification steps, including submission of a government issued photo ID. We conduct identity verification during interviews, and final interviews may require onsite attendance. All candidates must complete a comprehensive background check, in\-person I\-9 verification, and may be subject to drug screening prior to employment. The use of artificial intelligence tools during interviews is prohibited and monitored. Misrepresentation will result in immediate disqualification from consideration.

**Mandatory Requirements:**

Employees must have a high\-speed broadband internet connection with a minimum speed of **50 Mbps** and the ability to set up a wired connection to their home network to ensure effective remote work. These requirements may be updated as needed by the business.

 **Evolent is an equal opportunity employer and considers all qualified applicants equally without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran status, or disability status.** **If you need reasonable accommodation to access the information provided on this website, please contact** **recruitingteam@evolent.com** **for further assistance.**

As part of our total compensation package, Evolent is proud to offer comprehensive benefits (including health insurance benefits) to qualifying employees. All compensation determinations are based on the skills and experience required for the position and commensurate with experience of selected individuals, which may vary above and below the stated amounts.
